A field of 32 faced the starter and Arthur Allum at once jumped to the front, accompanied by Jack Flower. These two ran right away from the rest of the field and Carter led a small bunch who were intent on the third place.
Flower were in the lead after half a mile, followed by the “one-and-only” Footer and Mitchell. The rest of the field were bunched—a sure indication of a slow (or not too fast) start.
